tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Only works within allowed directories.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search for GitHub repositories. This tool requires the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable to be set. Returns: a paginated list of repository objects.

query.description: Search query. Include the search terms in the query parameter.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the connected database. Only SELECT statements are permitted. Do not use this tool for schema changes or any write operation.
